title: Transition W9: integrate runtime shadow-mode discovery traces (Phase 2)
description:
Workstream W9 of the integrated ADR 0020 transition design, Phase 2 (section
12.2): docs/audits/rules-awareness-transition/2026-07-30-integrated-transition-design.md.
That design is the accepted deliverable of eshyra-o9bd.19.8 (PR #485, reviewed
head afd113c7090378c3a9f4122f246a6c32602a5164, merge commit
042ce119aa699f04f60a1885d471335f07745282). ADR 0020 controls.

OWNER
This bead is the single owner of runtime shadow-mode observation for discovery.
No other bead owns it.

SCOPE
Run discovery in shadow mode on real turns, after assembleContext and before
renderContextMessage (the seam verified at orchestrator.ts:561 and :576), and
record, without altering DM input:

- explicit and derived signals;
- candidates and every retrieval route;
- relationship traversals;
- campaign-rule and ruling matches obtained through the eshyra-jhpt read seam;
- dedup decisions;
- priority band and retained candidates;
- rejected candidates, each with its reason;
- the proposed context packet;
- capability preflight results.

Shadow evidence attaches to the existing accepted-turn trace authority
(memory/turnTrace.ts TurnTraceRecord, written at orchestrator.ts:817) or returns
through that existing trace seam.

NON-GOALS AND PROHIBITIONS
- The DM sees exactly what it sees today. No packet is injected; changing DM
  input is W10.
- No competing readiness database, second campaign-rule store, or second finding
  registry (ADR 0017 section 8; ADR 0020 audit-architecture restraint).
- No discovery-owned campaign-rule persistence, ruling schema, or lifecycle;
  those stay with eshyra-jhpt.
- No claim of universal discovery completeness and no aggregate coverage figure.
  Measurements stay independent per probe and per stage.
- Presence of material in a shadow packet is never reported as evidence that the
  model used it.

BASELINE VALIDITY (design section 9.6)
Shadow evidence gathered before the applicable baseline repairs is diagnostic
only and may not be called a baseline. Specifically: no stat-block probe
evidence before B1 (eshyra-l3e5); no adventure-context evidence (P9) before B2
(eshyra-seoh); no deterministic-agreement measurement (M11) before B3
(eshyra-6vpw); no capability-agreement evidence (P8) before B5 (eshyra-uiax);
and table:starting-wealth-by-class is never treated as SRD authority at any time
(B4, eshyra-o9bd.19.2.1).

DEPENDENCIES
W8 accepted (Phase 1 exit criteria met), plus the baseline repairs applicable to
the probes being shadowed: eshyra-l3e5 (W1), eshyra-seoh (W2), eshyra-6vpw (W3),
eshyra-uiax (W5). Not parallel-safe with its own prerequisites.

PERMANENT EVIDENCE
Shadow traces for the probe corpus over real turns, attached to the existing
TurnTraceRecord seam; a test proving DM input is byte-identical with and without
shadow discovery enabled; M1-M11 derivable from the recorded trace without
re-running discovery.

REQUIRED NEXT STATE
Shadow traces exist for the probe corpus over real turns; every section-13
measurement through M11 is derivable from the trace; no new durable store was
introduced; each trace records which blockers were repaired at capture time so a
pre-repair capture can never be mistaken for a baseline.

MATERIAL CHANGE: yes. It adds a runtime observation point in the turn pipeline,
without changing what the DM receives.
acceptance_criteria:
Discovery runs after assembleContext and before renderContextMessage on real
turns. DM input is unchanged: a test proves the rendered context message is
identical with shadow discovery enabled and disabled. Shadow evidence attaches
to the existing accepted-turn trace authority (memory/turnTrace.ts
TurnTraceRecord) or returns through that existing trace seam; no competing
readiness store, campaign-rule store, or finding registry is created. Both
retained and rejected candidates are recorded with every retrieval route and
every rejection reason, and dedup preserves all routes. Campaign rules and
rulings come only from the eshyra-jhpt read seam. Each capture records which
baseline repairs were in place, and shadow evidence gathered before the
applicable repairs is labelled diagnostic-only and is never reported as a valid
baseline: no stat-block evidence before eshyra-l3e5, no P9 adventure-context
evidence before eshyra-seoh, no M11 deterministic-agreement measurement before
eshyra-6vpw, no P8 capability-agreement evidence before eshyra-uiax, and
table:starting-wealth-by-class never surfaces as SRD authority. M1-M11 are
derivable from the trace without re-running discovery, are reported
independently per probe, and are never aggregated into a coverage, readiness, or
completeness score. Packet presence is never reported as evidence that the model
used the material.

=========================================================================
PHASE-2 EVIDENCE TRUST MODEL (owner-authorized clarification, 2026-09-10)
=========================================================================
This clarification is design authority for W9 and for any successor reading design section 12.2's exit criteria. It resolves the review churn caused by reading "M1-M11 derivable from the trace without re-running discovery" as if it required the durable trace to be a self-authenticating semantic proof object. That reading was TOO STRONG. The accepted Phase-2 requirement is a DATA-SUFFICIENCY requirement over internally produced observational traces, not an arbitrary-tamper-detection requirement.

TRUST MODEL. discovery-shadow-v1 is an INTERNAL EXPERIMENTAL OBSERVATION FORMAT produced by Eshyra's W9 runtime instrumentation and persisted through the existing accepted-turn trace authority. A valid Phase-2 trace is assumed to originate from that producer and to have survived the ordinary persistence/JSON round trip.
The durable reader is responsible for FAIL-CLOSED ADMISSION of the stored format wherever malformed data could make measurement undefined or silently weaken meaning. It must reject, where applicable:
- an unknown schema version;
- missing or malformed required identity;
- unknown values in closed semantic discriminants where treating "unknown" as some weaker known case could false-green a measurement;
- structurally incomplete discriminated unions;
- impossible lifecycle shapes;
- missing required decision/event membership that would cause evidence to disappear silently;
- malformed values that measurement code would otherwise reinterpret as absence.
The reader is NOT responsible for detecting arbitrary post-persistence semantic tampering, nor for proving that every otherwise well-formed producer-owned observation really occurred. In particular it need not detect an attacker or hypothetical mutation that consistently rewrites several semantically related, otherwise valid fields. SQLite/turn-trace storage is NOT a hostile trust boundary in W9.
If future requirements need tamper evidence, cross-version forensic replay, cryptographic authenticity, or hostile-store validation, that is a SEPARATE design requirement and must be explicitly authorized, never inferred from Phase 2.

MEANING OF "DERIVABLE". For W9, M1-M11 are "derivable from the recorded trace without re-running discovery" when, after the trace has been persisted through the existing turn-trace seam and read back, the measurement functions can compute M1-M11 without rerunning discovery, resolving the live rules stack again, repeating jhpt rule/ruling queries, reinvoking deterministic capability preflight, or rerunning the turn auditor.
Producer-owned observations, events and decisions are LEGITIMATE PRIMITIVE INPUTS to those measurements. They do not need to be re-derived from some lower-level stored representation merely because another representation could imply them. Legitimate producer-owned primitive evidence includes: stage execution outcome; a relationship traversal that actually fired; a retention decision and its reason; a packet inclusion/exclusion decision and its reason; a jhpt seam query/result; a real capability-preflight invocation; an auditor retry/lifecycle event. The design does not recursively require every such observation to be proven from another durable fact.

REDUNDANCY RULE (replaces the over-strong working rule). The working rule "every semantically irreducible fact must appear exactly once, and every implication must be derived" is REPLACED by the narrower operational rule:
  Each M1-M11 measurement has a designated authoritative evidence source. Convenience or diagnostic fields may coexist when useful, provided measurement does not combine contradictory copies in a way that can false-green normal internally produced evidence.
Do not reopen the current implementation merely because two stored observations have semantic implications for one another. A redundancy becomes a W9 defect ONLY when, under the supported producer/persistence/reader path, it can cause the measurement implementation to report a materially different result from the evidence source designated for that measurement. Arbitrary coordinated editing of persisted JSON is OUTSIDE this Phase-2 threat model.

STAGE OUTCOMES. ran / skipped / failed-to-run are PRODUCER-OWNED STAGE OBSERVATIONS under the Phase-1/Phase-2 experiment contract. They do not have to be inferred by the durable reader solely from output membership. Their meanings remain those of the accepted design:
- ran: the stage performed its defined work, INCLUDING a seam query that executed and returned no results;
- skipped: one of the specifically conditional stages had nothing applicable to do;
- failed-to-run: a non-conditional stage produced no usable stage evidence under the experiment's diagnostic accounting.
skipped remains DISTINCT FROM SUCCESS. failed-to-run remains NON-GREEN (design section 13.3; ADR 0020 section 3). The reader should validate closed lifecycle vocabulary and structurally impossible combinations where useful, but it is NOT required to rediscover the stage's execution history independently.

BASELINE QUALIFICATION. Authoritative Phase-2 baseline eligibility comes from the accepted transition plan (section 9.6 entry criteria) PLUS the actual resolved dependency/blocker state for the experiment. A trace does NOT have to independently prove that repository history contains every prerequisite repair.
Capture-local B1-B5 observations remain useful DIAGNOSTIC evidence about what the trace could discriminate at runtime. A 'not-discriminable' observation -- especially B2, whose repair is a CLI handoff outside core's observation boundary -- does NOT mean the prerequisite is unrepaired and does NOT invalidate an otherwise eligible Phase-2 trace. Pre-repair evidence remains diagnostic-only exactly as the integrated design requires (section 9.6; section 12.2 entry criteria).
Do not infer baseline eligibility from a vacuous or incomplete blocker list; equally, do not require the runtime trace to self-certify repository/process history.
B3/M11 ERRATUM RETAINED (see DESCRIPTION ERRATUM below): B3 gates the Phase-3 deterministic state-effect agreement measurement M12, NOT the Phase-2 M11 auditor retry count.

FORMAT LIFETIME. discovery-shadow-v1 is a PHASE-2 EXPERIMENTAL EVIDENCE FORMAT, not a public protocol and not a permanent canonical replay schema. W9 requires: current-format production; persistence through the existing turn-trace seam; successful current-format reread; and M1-M11 data sufficiency. It does NOT establish a promise of indefinite backward-compatible migration for every historical shadow schema. Unknown/unsupported schema versions must FAIL EXPLICITLY rather than become "no evidence". A future workstream may define migration/forensic compatibility if it becomes necessary.

=========================================================================
ACCEPTED AT THE APPROVED HEAD (8b67c33, review #5163108225)
=========================================================================
- M10 remains producer-observed at the real capability-preflight boundary, with exact capability and subject identity, audit-rejected-attempt preservation, and NO change to the public use_item result contract.
- Retention and packet dispositions are producer-owned decisions carrying explicit reasons.
- Expansion traversal events are stage-local producer events, so the same traversal may fire in BOTH bounded passes even when cumulative candidate state does not change.
- Closed discovery discriminants fail closed where an unknown value could soften measurement meaning; campaign-rule kind is validated from the jhpt/campaign owner rather than redefined by discovery.
- M11 derives from the recorded audit lifecycle.
- All authored W7 execution cases, including BOTH P7 executions, are exercised over real turns.
- The trace attaches to the existing TurnTraceRecord authority; no competing store.
- Shadow mode does not alter DM/model input.
- Packet intervention remains W10 (eshyra-o9bd.19.12).

=========================================================================
IMPLEMENTATION AS MERGED
=========================================================================
EVENT VS STATE (review 7 repair). A canonical fact is of exactly one of two kinds and neither is reconstructed from the other:
- STATE = what exists after a stage (candidate streams, packet content, a candidate's cumulative .traversals);
- EVENT/DECISION = what happened while it ran (a relationship the pass traversed, a candidate it excluded and why).
Producer-owned DECISIONS: retention dispositions (recorded at the ranking/budget comparison) and packet inclusion decisions (recorded at the byte comparison), both as the discriminated CandidateDisposition, so an exclusion cannot exist without its reason and a retained decision cannot carry one. The live RetentionTrace/PacketTrace convenience views (outputs, dropped, overflow, overflowed, losses, byte drops, byte overflow) are DERIVED from those lists, which also collapsed the two competing strings for one count-budget rejection into a single causal reason.
Producer-owned EVENTS: ProjectedExpansionStage.traversalEvents, copied from ExpansionTrace.traversals. Defining a stage's traversals as "newly appearing on the candidate stream" was false under the bounded two-pass architecture -- a relationship promoted into campaign-rule expansion fires again while cumulative state does not move -- so traversalsOf() is deleted. Not deduplicated across stages.
projectDiscoveryTrace() only COPIES. The packet-decision reconstruction and its invented fallback reason 'excluded from the packet' are gone; the derivation throws on an unexpected decision instead of skipping it.
The reader enforces the narrow event/state integrity relation (endpoints emitted, endpoints carry it afterwards, no repeat within one pass, gained state explained by an event, skipped traverses nothing) WITHOUT a global set difference: a repeat is legal and an applicable stage that found no links is legal.
CLOSED DISCRIMINANTS FAIL CLOSED. routeClass was an arbitrary string while candidateBand() sent every unrecognized value to exploratory, so a corrupted direct-state-ref could soften a mandatory drop and turn M6 green. The reader pins the v1 route vocabulary independently of the producer; candidateBand() is an exhaustive Record<RouteClass, CandidateBand> that fails to compile until a new route is classified and throws on an impossible one. Signal kind, candidate targetKind, pack role (base/addon by position) and projection-limit kind are validated the same way. ruleKind goes through the OWNER's isCampaignRuleKind()/CAMPAIGN_RULE_KINDS, exported from campaign/campaignRules.ts -- discovery does not define that domain, the deliberate contrast with the discovery-owned route list. Lifecycle siblings rejected: skipped with traversal events or a seam query, failed-to-run beside decisions, empty exclusion reason; pass-through on a skipped stage stays legal.
PERMANENT EVIDENCE: a repeated-traversal regression built from the real producers (condition:incapacitated must-consider -> expansion 1 traverses the action:dodge exclusion edge -> a jhpt house rule governing Dodge promotes it -> pass 2 traverses the same edge), verified to FAIL against the deleted traversalsOf(); real count-budget and byte-budget exclusion cases; reason removed/emptied, decision removed, event-without-carrier, state-without-event, carried-not-fired, fired-again; and mutations for every closed discriminant. traceDerivation.test.ts compares projected dispositions, packet decisions and both stages' traversal events against the LIVE producer trace across all 13 corpus executions.
Verification at 8b67c33: focused discovery suite 220 passed; npm run verify:worktree exit 0, 5251 passed / 20 skipped.

DURABLE RECORD SHAPE. The v1 record stores canonical facts and derives every M1-M11 summary at measurement time in discovery/traceDerivation.ts. Read this section under the REDUNDANCY RULE above -- it describes what the implementation does, and is NOT a standing requirement that every implication be eliminated:
- one candidate stream per stage; produced/modified/carried-forward derived, with a candidate's rule evidence taken from the join PLACEMENTS, not a copy on the candidate;
- expansion stages store their traversal EVENTS; a candidate's .traversals remains cumulative state;
- rule joins store seamQueries, the jhpt projections returned (unchanged, jhpt-owned type -- discovery declares no rule schema), placements and consideredAmbiguityIds; every M5 summary including returned/matched/unplaced/resolved is derived;
- retention stores one producer-authored disposition per candidate it decided over; retained/dropped/overflow/overflowed/losses derived;
- the packet stores one producer-authored inclusion decision per retained candidate plus the included content (two different facts); bytes, byte overflow, drop list and losses derived;
- audit is a discriminated lifecycle (absent | present with retries + accepted/repaired outcome), so an accepted verdict with a retry cause, an intermediate acceptance, a failing terminal state and a non-sequential attempt are UNREPRESENTABLE; M11 auditor presence and causes derive from it;
- stage outcome is a PRODUCER-OWNED OBSERVATION (see STAGE OUTCOMES above), validated for closed vocabulary and impossible combinations rather than re-derived;
- band, stageOrder, failedToRun, oracleSuppliedSignalLabels and unexpandedPromotions are derived, not stored.
readDiscoveryShadowEvidence is admissibility: schema, identity, closed discriminants, decision COVERAGE and lifecycle. Its stage table, route vocabulary and blocker set are declared in the validator independently of the producer; control-verified by renaming a producer stage and by dropping B5.

M10 DESIGN (accepted at review 4 and unchanged since). The runtime event is the instant preflightCampaignItemOperation returns, observed over a PRIVATE seam (UseItemInput.onCapabilityInvocation -> ToolContext.observeCapabilityInvocation -> a turn-owned buffer outside the candidate savepoint). Public tool results stay at their pre-W9 shape; events include audit-rejected attempts; M10 never reconstructs from a terminal tool result or a pre-model snapshot.

DESCRIPTION ERRATUM. This bead's BASELINE VALIDITY section says 'no deterministic-agreement measurement (M11) before B3', repeating design section 9.6. Corrected by design section 9.6 Erratum 1 (recorded in a20b1f6): section 13.1 defines M11 as auditor retry count and M12 as accepted state-effect agreement, so the measurement B3 gates is M12 -- a Phase 3 measurement. B3 therefore gates NO Phase 2 measurement, though it remains a prerequisite for a probe resolving an add-on stack (P11).

OTHER DELIVERED PIECES: capture-time B1-B5 observation (a probe must be unable to report 'repaired' for a defect it still contains; B2 is permanently not-discriminable from core -- see BASELINE QUALIFICATION above); total capture (trace XOR failure); one pinned pack resolution per capture; turn_trace.discovery_shadow (migration 0031) with no new store.

RUNTIME FINDINGS (recorded, not tolerated; successor questions for W10 eshyra-o9bd.19.12): P1/P2 lose their targets at 'signals' because their cues read fixture state fields with no live StateSnapshot equivalent; P5 misses rule:concentration; a real turn's shadow packet preflights nothing, so a real use_item event is reported as absent from the packet.

EXCLUSIONS: no CLI flag; no packet injection (W10).

CLOSURE. The deliverable was PR #539; it merged at 71c322f with no source change after the approving review, so this bead is closed. The PHASE-2 EVIDENCE TRUST MODEL section above is durable design authority for W9 and for any successor reading design section 12.2's exit criteria -- read it before reopening any 'canonical evidence' question against discovery-shadow-v1.
